limitations: IPC payloads are represented by value shapes; payload values are never retained.
IPC direction and sender/receiver identifiers are observed only where Electron exposes them at the hooked boundary.
The runtime timeline records lifecycle, navigation, shell, permission, popup, download, protocol, preload, native-addon, process, and IPC events; activity before hook installation is unavailable.

The preload and renderer process contexts are not instrumented by the main-process -r hook; preload configuration and contextBridge API-shape events are main-boundary observations, not proof of renderer-side execution.
Process metrics are an Electron API snapshot and do not prove hostile-local-user isolation.

External shell opens, external navigation, permission grants, downloads, popup windows, updater relaunches, and OS integration are blocked and recorded by the active hook; other application filesystem and network behavior is not sandboxed by this provider.

limits: All four real trials complete the declared dialog recovery and shape insertion but fail overall provider cleanup; no complete-workflow pass or latency/CPU/memory speedup is established.
Baseline-2 also has Xvfb temporary-directory cleanup failure (payload exit5, outer wrapper failure). Its directory identity was not captured; no broad path-based cleanup was attempted.

DOM cells counts refer only to data-cell-id attributes, which this app does not expose; they do not measure the mxGraph model. The independent insertion oracle uses SVG elements and the actual unsaved-changes UI.
The official packaged runtime refuses Inspector via fuse; results apply only to its unchanged ASAR on the selected generic runtime.
The recovery scenario intentionally dismisses the observed invalid-file dialog; it does not establish normal startup compatibility.
Live-model tokens, agent context, whole-task tool-schema/call costs, actual MCP-wire parity and completed-task performance remain unmeasured. Fewer retained events do not establish token savings.
Earlier diagnostic helper hashes were not captured. Only the four formal trials have the pre-run manifest; failed attempts were not overwritten.
Application images, extracted resources/profiles and full Result files are regenerable local inputs/outputs, not committed data.

Historical captures omit unrelated full timeline/process arrays and exploratory palette/body listings; original logs remain identified by digest. Boolean invalid-file text projections are derived from the recorded renderer excerpt.

review_followup.root_cause: Translation inside a patched removeListener happened after application decorators had already received the raw on wrapper.
review_followup.structural_fix: Native removeAllListeners runs through a private forwarding receiver sharing the real emitter state; owned on entries are normalized before current app method/decorator invocation. Real receivers, reentrant replacement, readonly methods, getters and Proxy decorators are preserved. Public removeListener/off patches are removed. Canonical removal targets are held in the weak registry independently of mutable public metadata; changed getters run at the native deletion stage.
